system.flavor: Highly reliable, well-made plastic composite assault rifle - the U.S. Army's caseless service weapon and the re-engineered Sternmeyer CG-13 export version.
system.notes:
Solo of Fortune p.38 (PDF idx 39) carries the stat box as a page graphic; a fresh tesseract OCR pass over it yields RIF ? N P 5.56 caseless 90 48 VR, 'US assault rifle, $695-750' - the WA cell would not resolve. Prices in the SoF review prose: CG-13 $695 list (p.40), M-95A2 civilian $750 (p.41).

Stat cells taken from Blackhand's Street Weapons p.29 (PDF idx 30), which prints the entry complete: RIF +1 N R 5D6 (5.56MM) 90 3/30 VR 400M, 695-750eb. Model designation 'M-95A4 (CG-13B)' is Corpbook 1 p.66's own spelling. Cross-reference: Interface Vol.1 #1 p.29 compilation table prints RIF 1 N P 5.56 CL 90 48 VR 1400. Cost stored as the low end of the printed 695-750eb range.
